== Source, printing and text-state verification (Story 386) ==
The [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-world-championship-abe-christensen-ds-more-systems-will-rally-to-our-cause/ published Players Committee decklist] was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds Christensen DS Rally.txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card articles linked in the table. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114030949/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2026-world-championship-abe-christensen-ds-more-systems-will-rally-to-our-cause.html Players Committee decklist]. The download's File page attributes the XML to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The download contains 60 constructed-card entries. Its SHA-256 is <code>cc96d3d56001984879dc85d8f1f70b19bc2e728f23701d71af9e2b3c06613859</code>; the download bytes were retained. The article lists 60 constructed cards and 34 outside-deck cards. Each outside-deck XML identity is counted separately; a card outside the deck is placed in its own card-type group when it is not a Defensive Shield.

=== Printing choices ===
* 3x [[Count Dooku (ALT) (Errata 2)]]: XML <nowiki>200_76^</nowiki>. The explicit XML image variant is represented by the existing ALT article and its matching published image.
* 1x [[General Grievous (ALT) (Errata 3)]]: XML <nowiki>203_27^</nowiki>. The explicit XML image variant is represented by the existing ALT article and its matching published image.
